messages:
kai: dropped a compact-nav mock + short RFC note. Aim: regroup sidebar into Workflows, Tools, Admin; stable deep links; breadcrumb truncation rules. Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-ia-rfckey :mag:

reema: nice. routing question up front: we have external links to /console/models/:id and old marketing links using hashes. Plan to keep those working?

oscar: propose server 301s for public routes and client-side canonicalize fallback during rollout. Also return X-Deprecated-Path header for telemetry.

iky (ivy): a11y: when a group collapses make sure focus moves to the toggle, use aria-expanded + aria-controls, and announce state via aria-live polite. Increase chevron target to 44px.

nav-bot: [a11y-scan] icons contrast 3.6:1 on accent bg; recommend thicker stroke or #eef0f2 fill for >=4.5:1. Missing aria-label on utility toggle.

sara: breadcrumb microcopy: prefer plural root + slash separators: "Models / MyModel / Versions". Truncation: always show first and last crumb, ellipsize middle, tooltip on hover for truncated crumbs. Active crumb use aria-current=\"page\".

reema: routing edge-case: support both path-encoded views (/versions) and query-based (?tab=versions). Map old subpath -> query in rewrite rules. Also log legacy in query for analytics e.g. ?legacy=/models/123/versions.

oscar: tiny client helper we can ship in staging:
```
function normalizeIncoming(href){
  const url = new URL(href, location.origin)
  let path = url.pathname !== '/' ? url.pathname : url.hash.replace('#','')
  path = stripLegacySegments(path) // convert /versions -> ?tab=versions
  return { path: normalize(path), query: mapViewToQuery(path) }
}
```
call before router.resolve.

kai: routing priority for RFC proposal: 1) exact new path, 2) server rewrite/301, 3) client canonicalize -> query fallback, 4) hash fallback, 5) global-search fallback. Agree?

sara: +1. A/B test slash vs chevron separators and breadcrumb truncation. Metrics: breadcrumb_click_rate, time_to_first_action, nav_abandonment. Start small (2%).

iky (ivy): keyboard shortcut idea: `g m` -> Models, `g d` -> Deployments. Ensure focus lands on first actionable item and expose a11y docs.

reema: actionables: (1) Oscar draft rewrite table + X-Deprecated-Path header example (owner: oscar, due: Tue), (2) Ivy write keyboard + ARIA checklist + focus flows (owner: ivy, due: Wed), (3) Sara write A/B spec + telemetry events (owner: sara, due: Wed), (4) Kai update RFC with priority list and add redirect sample (owner: kai, due: Thu).

kai: thanks all 44d I'll update Figma with contrast + hit-target fixes and push a prototype with the breadcrumb truncation behavior.
